items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: From Joe Smith, to Rex Stewart, to the trumpet player that did all the writing for McKenna's Cotton Pickers... All these guys were different... I did play with them

ctx.x: -- and meet musicians that came through, like Joe Smith came through there with, I think, Ethel Waters at one time and then all of the show bands came through there, that were on the circuit --
